decoys.why: Three single failures with three different named one-time causes: a provider outage, an overnight system update restart and an expired engine sign-in.
Three single CI rechecks with different named causes: a registry outage, a browser download timeout and a full runner disk.
One escalation of a genuine privacy decision (who may read injury reports) that the operator took.
The third billing review and the merge hold were both the operator's own requests for a payments change.
Two unrelated small requests after reports (a deposit line, a description field) and one low finding left open with the operator's agreement.
